segments.ja370:1.3: Aṅkasmiṃ [aṅgasmiṃ (ka.)] te nisinnova, so te mammāni checchati [chijjati (ka.)].
segments.ja370:2.3: Yathā pitā ca mātā ca [pitā vā mātā vā (pī.), mātā vā pitā vā (ka.)], evaṃ me so bhavissati.
segments.ja370:3.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ aṅkasmiṃ vaḍḍhesi, khīrarukkhaṃ bhayānakaṃ;
segments.ja370:3.3: Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma, vuḍḍhi massa na ruccati.
segments.ja370:5.1: Na tassa vuḍḍhi kusalappasatthā, yo vaḍḍhamāno ghasate patiṭṭhaṃ;
